order: no subsequent local operation or frozen write
manifest_covers: Every own file recursively, including helpers, frozen inputs, reports, plans, response, ledgers, locks, before/after results, PNGs, outputs and every receipt completed before hashing
why: Manifest cannot hash itself; terminal runner receipt/output do not exist at manifest snapshot and are emitted on synchronous completion. These exact terminal files are the only exclusions. No wildcard exclusions.
receipt_resources: Terminal receipt records its own actual completion separately; no post-completion hash/read promised
